title: [AUG-214] Client: show action item context and jump to the source line in ActionItemsPanel (live column and session card)
why_we_need_this:
After a meeting the user reviews a list of short action item titles and cannot tell what each one is about, who asked or why, so items cannot be triaged, edited or sent to Praxis with confidence. The server task stores a summary, a source quote, the speaker and the time for every item; this task shows them to the user as approved in the mockup @docs/mockups/AUG-211/action-item-context.html (research: @docs/mockups/AUG-211/findings.md).

Result: the summary is readable without a click, the quote and "who said it, when" are one click away, and the user can jump to the exact line in the transcript instead of searching for it by hand.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Collapsed item card in the `live` and `session` variants shows, under the title, the summary clamped to 2 lines; without a summary it shows the start of the quote in «…»; for an item added by hand it shows `Added by hand at HH:MM:SS`; with no source at all the row is absent.
- [ ] The meta row has a time chip `HH:MM:SS ↗` and a `Context ▾/▴` toggle (`aria-expanded`); the expanded block shows the full summary with an `Edit` button, `SAID BY <NAME> · HH:MM:SS` and the verbatim quote, and `Show in transcript`; texts match the mockup.
- [ ] Editing the summary saves through the existing edit path (live frame / session PATCH) and the card shows `Edited by you`; Escape restores the previous text.
- [ ] Live panel: the time chip and `Show in transcript` scroll the live transcript to the source line and highlight it with the `SOURCE OF ACTION ITEM` tag; the owning card gets an accent outline; clicking the highlighted line scrolls to its card and expands it.
- [ ] Live panel after Clear / Copy & Clear: summary and quote stay, the jump controls are disabled with the note from the mockup.
- [ ] TranscriptView: the jump scrolls to and highlights the transcript line given by the item's stored line index, in the transcript version currently shown (original or corrected); while transcription is running the jump controls are disabled and the yellow-outlined note from the mockup is shown.
- [ ] Old sessions (items without a source): the expanded block shows `No source was saved for this item (recorded before this feature).` and `Find in transcript`, which finds the best matching line by word overlap with the item text without any model call, jumps to it, or shows `No matching line found.`
- [ ] The `compact` variant (Dock Strip, Ghost Caption) is visually unchanged (compare with screenshots in @docs/reviews/AUG-204).
- [ ] Brandbook: 0 border-radius, the only filled green control in the panel stays `Separate tasks`, new controls are outline, red only on delete hover; no model names, scores, ids or millisecond values anywhere in the UI.
- [ ] The 300 px ACTION ITEMS column shows no horizontal scroll and no clipped controls at 960×600, 1280×866 and 1920×1040, light and dark; screenshots of the live column and the session card (collapsed, expanded, highlighted line, each state above) are saved under @docs/reviews/ for this task.
- [ ] All new controls are reachable and operable by keyboard with a visible focus outline; `npm test` and the client build pass.
important_constraints:
- Order: 2/3. Depends on: AUG-213-b8mq4z (server anchors and context). Blocks: AUG-215-57bit6 (audio playback). Research: AUG-211-yw2f5w.
- Design source: the approved mockup @docs/mockups/AUG-211/action-item-context.html; do not redesign. The `▶ Play from here` button in the mockup is NOT part of this task (AUG-215).
- Do not change server data rules; if a field the UI needs is missing, stop and report instead of adding model calls.
- ActionItemsPanel is shared by the live column, TranscriptView and the compact widgets — check all three after the change.
- Live columns fitting rule (AUG-205) and the pin-bar reserve (AUG-206) must keep working.
- Same behaviour on Windows and macOS; no platform-specific code.
